rows.grounds: duration of practice; compound of six and month
steadfast or disciplined manner of practice
faculty that arises; compound of speech and intelligence

items.question: What faculty arises from six months of regular devotion to the goddess?
premises: A practitioner engages in regular devotion for six months.
The devotion is directed toward the goddess.
Speech and intelligence arise in that practitioner.
items.inference: Sustained regular devotion to the goddess produces speech and intelligence in the practitioner.
uncertainties: The specific devotional act is implied from the preceding verses rather than stated explicitly.
items.plain_english: If one regularly worships the goddess for six months, speech and intelligence arise in him.
